notes.title: New Achievement!
notes.content:
It’s time to shell-ebrate! A new achievement is done and here. Even though there is already a good shell-ection, it never hurts to have more.

It's big. It's old. It's hard to find.
 
The new achievement is called, [b]Squish![/b]

[i]'Find an old friend tenfold with love' to unlock this new achievement.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31003567/7edc33bc05b58b8cbf02725e6acf0a40bb96c4c4.png[/img]
